specs.Connector Type: Lightning, USB Type A, USB Type C

features: Four Charging Modes in One Cable: Experience the convenience of one cable with four charging modes. Switch between Type C to Lightning, USB to Lightning, Type C to Type C, and USB to Type C.
60W Max Power Delivery: This 4 in 1 Charging Cable with metal heads supports up to 60W max Power Delivery (Type C to Type C charging), ensuring your devices charge quickly and efficiently.
Versatile 4 in 1 Cable: One cable for Lightning mobiles, AirPods, android phones, MacBooks, iPads, earbuds, chargers, car chargers, laptops, and power banks. Your go-to charging solution.
1-Meter Nylon Braided Cable: Our 1-meter nylon braided multifunctional cable is built to withstand wear and tear, offering a tangle-free experience while providing exceptional durability.
Fast Charging Capabilities: With 12W USB to Lightning, 20W Type-C to Lightning, 30W USB to Type-C, and 60W Type-C to Type-C Fast Charging, your devices will be ready to use in no time.
High-Speed Data Transfer: Need to transfer files quickly? Enjoy data speeds of up to 480 Mbps, enabling swift and seamless data transfers between your devices.
Unique Design: Smooth changing between charging modes. The unique design of the multiuse cable allows for easy switching, making charging your USB, Lightning, and Type C port devices a breeze.
